SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_num AS employeeNum, e.employee_name AS employeeName, f.file_url AS profileFileUrl, o.org_name AS orgName, p.position_name AS positionName, j.job_name AS jobName, r.rank_name AS rankName, e.employ_state AS employeeState, e.hire_date AS hireDate, h.employ_type AS employType, w.area_name AS areaName FROM employee e LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.* FROM employee_hr_info x JOIN ( SELECT employee_id, MAX(effective_from) AS effective_from FROM employee_hr_info GROUP BY employee_id ) latest ON latest.employee_id = x.employee_id AND latest.effective_from = x.effective_from ) h ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = h.org_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.position_id = h.position_id LEFT JOIN hr_rank r ON r.rank_id = h.rank_id LEFT JOIN job j ON j.job_id = h.job_id LEFT JOIN working_area w ON w.area_id = h.area_id LEFT JOIN hr_file f ON f.hr_file_id = e.profile_id
ORDER BY e.employee_name ASC, e.employee_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_num AS employeeNum, e.employee_name AS employeeName, f.file_url AS profileFileUrl, e.email AS email, e.phone AS phone, e.ext AS extensionNum, e.address AS address, e.birth_date AS birthDate, o.org_name AS orgName, p.position_name AS positionName, j.job_name AS jobName, r.rank_name AS rankName, e.employ_state AS employeeState, e.hire_date AS hireDate, h.employ_type AS employType, h.recruit_type AS recruitType, w.area_name AS areaName, e.bank_name AS bankName, e.resident_number_enc AS residentNumberEnc, e.account_number_enc AS accountNumberEnc FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = h.org_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.position_id = h.position_id LEFT JOIN hr_rank r ON r.rank_id = h.rank_id LEFT JOIN job j ON j.job_id = h.job_id LEFT JOIN working_area w ON w.area_id = h.area_id LEFT JOIN hr_file f ON f.hr_file_id = e.profile_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT he.hr_event_id AS hrEventId, he.event_type AS eventType, he.event_title AS eventTitle, he.effective_from AS effectiveFrom, he.effective_to AS effectiveTo, he.reason AS reason, he.before_change AS beforeChange, he.after_change AS afterChange, he.source_approval_id AS sourceApprovalId, he.event_status AS eventStatus, he.applied_at AS appliedAt, he.applied_error AS appliedError FROM hr_event he WHERE he.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND he.event_status = 'APPLIED' ORDER BY he.effective_from DESC, he.hr_event_id DESC
